scope: Context compaction, shared sparse inspection, sequential workspace verification

skip_reasons: optional Amulet unavailable in render environment

native.navigation: blocked: macOS foreground is loginwindow; requires unlocked session

regression: Inspection of 64 cells in a 256-cell overlay does not iterate the entire overlay; subprocess checks cover failure, missing tools, timeout, descendant termination and refusal to reuse output.
limitations: Native focus/capture is not validated while the session is locked.
This phase does not establish whole-package type completeness or Windows/Linux GUI support.
